audience: pre-service D4 BIKBP and Tourism students

competencies.definition: Complete guest-facing service exchanges coherently from opening through closure.
competencies.name: Guest-service interaction

competencies.definition: Elicit, check, confirm and pass on guest/service information accurately.
competencies.name: Information accuracy and clarification

competencies.definition: Use respectful, warm and channel-appropriate language, tone and attitude.
competencies.name: Hospitality rapport, politeness and register

competencies.definition: Listen, acknowledge, take ownership, propose action and follow up without blame or dismissal.
competencies.name: Positive-language problem solving

competencies.definition: Adapt service communication to face-to-face, telephone, written, live-chat and public/private online channels.
competencies.name: Channel-specific communication

competencies.definition: Clarify needs and connect guests or colleagues to the correct person/department while preserving meaning.
competencies.name: Department handoff and mediation

competencies.definition: Monitor confidence, emotional response and next practice action without treating self-report as proficiency.
competencies.name: Self-regulation and reflective readiness
